Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The DataVerification_Expert failed to verify that Yosemite Falls was recommended as fully wheelchair accessible by at least three different people. While the expert mentioned that the Lower Yosemite Falls Trail is fully paved and wheelchair accessible and that it was "recommended by multiple sources," no evidence was provided that explicitly confirmed that at least three different people recommended it as fully wheelchair accessible. This oversight directly led to the incorrect conclusion that Yosemite Falls met all criteria, as the verification of the specific condition (recommendation by at least three different people) was incomplete or unsubstantiated.
